notes.title: Easy mode implemented
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new difficulty setting.
[*] Easy mode has 8 hp and drops are more common.
[*] Normal mode has had a slight increase in drops.
[/list]

Thank you.

notes.title: The Hell Inside Easter Event
notes.content:
The Hell Inside Easter Event has begun.

Players can unlock a new seasonal skin by collecting 5 Golden Eggs dropped by enemies.

A new page has been permanently added, the Bunny Hop page.

The event ends on the 12th of April.

Thank you.

notes.title: The Hell Inside Easter Event
notes.content:
The Hell Inside Easter Event is here until April 12th.

This includes a new skin to unlock by collecting 5 golden eggs.

Also, a new page has been added permanently, the Bunny Hop page.

Thank you.
